layers.title: Protocol, public contracts and shared libraries
Gateways in front of the brokers

components.title: Binary wire protocol (PulsarApi.proto)
components.one_line: The protobuf command and MessageMetadata definitions every client, broker and proxy speak, generated with LightProto; markers for replication and transactions live beside it in PulsarMarkers.proto.

components.title: Java client API (v4)
components.one_line: Public, backward-compatible interfaces for PulsarClient, Producer, Consumer, Reader, TableView, Schema and the interface-taxonomy annotations; Java 17 bytecode.

components.title: Java client API v5
components.one_line: The newer client API where a topic is opaque (no partitions, no router) and scalable topics are first-class; ships beside v4 without changing it (PIP-466).
evidence: pulsar-client/build.gradle.kts:38 api(project(":pulsar-client-api-v5")) - the v4 implementation also exports the v5 API

components.title: Admin API and policy data model
components.one_line: The PulsarAdmin interfaces and the policy, stats and tenant/namespace/topic data types every admin surface shares.
evidence: pulsar-common/build.gradle.kts:154 api(project(":pulsar-client-admin-api")) - common sits ABOVE the admin API

components.title: pulsar-common
components.one_line: Shared library under every server and client: topic/namespace naming, policy implementations, compression, the allocator, NAR class loading, JSON mappers and the protocol helpers.
evidence: pulsar-common/build.gradle.kts:152-154 depends on pulsar-tls-factory-api, pulsar-client-api, pulsar-client-admin-api

components.title: Metrics and observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus stats, logging)
components.one_line: OpenTelemetry scaffolding shared by broker, proxy, worker, managed ledger and transaction coordinator, plus the broker's Prometheus stats and the structured-logging conventions.
evidence: managed-ledger/build.gradle.kts:28, pulsar-broker/build.gradle.kts:41, pulsar-proxy/build.gradle.kts:35, pulsar-functions/worker/build.gradle.kts:42, pulsar-transaction/coordinator build use pulsar-opentelemetry

components.title: pulsar-broker-common (configuration, metadata resources, web plumbing)
components.one_line: Server-side library shared by broker, proxy, websocket and the functions worker: ServiceConfiguration, PulsarResources over the metadata store, topic-list memory limiter, Jetty/TLS helpers, rack awareness.
evidence: pulsar-broker-common/build.gradle.kts depends on pulsar-common, pulsar-metadata, pulsar-tls-factory-api
pulsar-proxy/build.gradle.kts:27, pulsar-websocket/build.gradle.kts:26, pulsar-functions/worker/build.gradle.kts:41, pulsar-functions/runtime build all api(project(":pulsar-broker-common"))
pulsar-broker-common/src/main/java/org/apache/pulsar/broker/topiclistlimit (PIP-442 limiter used by broker and proxy)

components.title: Security: authentication, authorization and TLS
components.one_line: Pluggable AuthenticationProvider/AuthorizationProvider on the server, Authentication plugins in the client, the auth plugin modules (OIDC, SASL, Athenz), and the TLS-factory and HTTP-client SPIs.
evidence: pulsar-broker-auth-sasl/build.gradle.kts:33 implementation(project(":pulsar-broker")) - a plugin depending on the whole broker

components.title: Managed ledger and cursors
components.one_line: The storage abstraction the broker reads and writes through: append-only ledgers of entries, cursors tracking subscription positions, the entry cache, ledger trimming and offload hooks.
evidence: managed-ledger/build.gradle.kts:26-28 depends on pulsar-common, pulsar-metadata, pulsar-opentelemetry

components.title: BookKeeper client boundary
components.one_line: Where Pulsar meets Apache BookKeeper: the broker's BookKeeper client factory, the metadata driver that makes BookKeeper keep ITS metadata in Pulsar's metadata store, the BK metrics provider and the mock BookKeeper used in tests.
evidence: bin/pulsar:399 'Pulsar Metadata driver will be used for Bookkeeper client and server metadata operations'

Direct org.apache.bookkeeper.client imports outside managed-ledger: pulsar-broker/src/main/java/org/apache/pulsar/broker/service/schema/BookkeeperSchemaStorage.java, pulsar-broker/src/main/java/org/apache/pulsar/broker/delayed/bucket/BookkeeperBucketSnapshotStorage.java, pulsar-broker/src/main/java/org/apache/pulsar/compaction/*Compactor.java, pulsar-broker/src/main/java/org/apache/pulsar/broker/transaction/pendingack/impl/PendingAckHandleImpl.java, pulsar-functions/instance/.../state/BKStateStoreProviderImpl.java; DistributedLog in pulsar-functions/worker/.../dlog and pulsar-package-management/bookkeeper-storage

components.title: Tiered storage (offloaders)
components.one_line: Moves sealed ledger data to object stores or a filesystem behind the LedgerOffloader interface and reads it back; loaded by the managed ledger as NAR plugins.

components.title: Metadata store (ZooKeeper, Oxia, RocksDB, memory)
components.one_line: Pluggable MetadataStore and CoordinationService (locks, leader election, counters) with ZooKeeper, Oxia, RocksDB and in-memory backends, metadata caches, table views, batching and the dual-store migration framework.
evidence: no Etcd backend in the code (PIP-462 removed it; PIP-135 added it)

components.title: Package management
components.one_line: Versioned function/sink/source packages addressed by URL, with filesystem and BookKeeper (DistributedLog) storage backends, served through the broker's admin API.

components.title: Broker service core
components.one_line: The server: PulsarService wires everything, BrokerService owns topics and connections, ServerCnx speaks the protocol, PersistentTopic/NonPersistentTopic publish and dedup, producers, TTL and topic lifecycle; standalone mode starts here.
evidence: pulsar-broker/build.gradle.kts:30-48 (api: managed-ledger, broker-common, client, websocket, transaction-coordinator, opentelemetry, functions-worker, package-core)

components.title: Subscriptions and dispatch
components.one_line: How entries leave a topic: subscription types (exclusive, failover, shared, Key_Shared), dispatchers and consumer selectors, redelivery and negative-ack tracking, draining hashes, entry buckets, ack-state pause.

components.title: Delayed message delivery
components.one_line: Per-message delayed and scheduled delivery for shared subscriptions: in-memory and bucket-based trackers, the latter snapshotting its index to BookKeeper.

components.title: Namespace bundles, ownership and topic lookup
components.one_line: Namespaces split into hash-range bundles, bundle ownership and splitting, topic lookup and redirection, advertised listeners.

components.title: Admin REST API and broker web layer
components.one_line: The broker's Jetty/Jersey web service: v2/v3 admin resources for tenants, namespaces, topics, schemas, functions, packages and transactions, the REST produce/consume endpoints and the web filters.

components.title: Load manager
components.one_line: Places namespace bundles on brokers and sheds load: the modular load manager with its shedding/placement strategies, and the extensible load manager with a bundle-state channel over table views.

components.title: Geo-replication
components.one_line: Replicates topics between clusters by running a Pulsar producer and admin client against the remote cluster, plus replicated subscriptions, shadow replication and cross-cluster policy/metadata sync.

components.title: Topic policies and system topics
components.one_line: Topic-level policies and the per-namespace __change_events system topic they travel on, the pluggable TopicPoliciesService with system-topic and metadata-store backends.

components.title: Topic compaction
components.one_line: Rewrites a topic's backlog into a ledger holding the latest value per key and serves compacted reads; pluggable TopicCompactionService with publish-order and event-time compactors.
evidence: pulsar-broker/src/main/java/org/apache/pulsar/client/impl/RawReaderImpl.java, CompactionReaderImpl.java (client-package classes living in the broker)

components.title: Schema registry
components.one_line: Broker-side schema storage, versioning and compatibility checking, plus the client-side Schema implementations (Avro, JSON, Protobuf native, external registries).

components.title: Transactions in the broker (buffer and pending ack)
components.one_line: The topic-side halves of transactions: the transaction buffer that hides uncommitted messages, pending-ack stores for transactional acks, snapshots on system topics, and the metadata-driven v5 transactions for scalable topics.

components.title: Transaction coordinator
components.one_line: The transaction coordinator's metadata store and transaction log over the managed ledger, with the buffered writer that batches log entries.

components.title: Rate limiting, quotas and resource groups
components.one_line: Publish, dispatch and subscribe rate limiters on the async token bucket, backlog quotas, and resource groups enforcing tenant/namespace quotas across brokers.

components.title: Broker extension points (protocol handlers, interceptors, entry filters, topic factory)
components.one_line: Plugin surfaces loaded from NARs: ProtocolHandler, BrokerInterceptor, EntryFilter, additional servlets and a pluggable TopicFactory; the proxy carries a parallel copy as ProxyExtensions.
evidence: pulsar-proxy/src/main/java/org/apache/pulsar/proxy/extensions/* mirrors broker/protocol/* file for file (ProtocolHandlerDefinitions 35 = ExtensionsDefinitions 35 lines, ProtocolHandlerMetadata 42 = ProxyExtensionMetadata 42)

components.title: Scalable topics (topics v5)
components.one_line: topic:// topics that split and merge range segments instead of fixing partitions: the per-topic leader-elected controller, segment DAG, auto split/merge, entry-bucket key-shared, migration from regular topics, and the client specification.

components.title: Pulsar proxy
components.one_line: Optional stateless gateway in front of brokers: discovers brokers through the metadata store, forwards binary-protocol connections and admin HTTP, embeds the WebSocket service and loads proxy extensions.

components.title: WebSocket service
components.one_line: A WebSocket-to-Pulsar bridge that turns WebSocket producers, consumers and readers into Pulsar client calls; runs inside the broker, inside the proxy or standalone.

components.title: Java client (v4 implementation)
components.one_line: The client implementation: connection pool, producers, consumers, readers, multi-topic and pattern consumers, TableView, batching, chunking, DLQ/retry, memory limits, end-to-end encryption, client-side schema and transactions, OTel metrics and tracing.
evidence: pulsar-client/src/main/java/org/apache/pulsar/client/impl/ConsumerImpl.java builds the dead-letter and retry producers (client-side, not broker-side)

components.title: Java client v5
components.one_line: The V5 client built as an adapter over the v4 client implementation, adding scalable-topic sessions.

components.title: Java admin client
components.one_line: The PulsarAdmin REST client implementing the admin API over HTTP.

components.title: CLI tools (pulsar-admin, pulsar-client, pulsar-shell)
components.one_line: The command-line tools on picocli, the CLI extension API (tools-api, custom-command example) and the shared CLI argument utilities.

components.title: Functions API
components.one_line: The Java Function, Context/BaseContext and window-function interfaces user code implements, and the API the IO connector framework extends.

components.title: Functions runtime and instance
components.one_line: Runs a function or connector: the Java instance, process/thread/Kubernetes runtimes, secrets providers, state stores, local runner, the Go and Python runtimes and the built-in functions.

components.title: Functions worker
components.one_line: The cluster service that accepts, schedules, assigns and runs functions, sources and sinks; it runs embedded in the broker or as its own process.

components.title: Pulsar IO connector framework
components.one_line: Source, Sink, PushSource and batch-source SDK that connectors implement, run by the functions runtime; the connectors themselves live in another repository.
evidence: ARCHITECTURE.md: built-in connectors moved to pulsar-connectors (PIP-465)

components.title: Build system (Gradle conventions, version catalog, BOM, shading)
components.one_line: The Gradle build: convention plugins, the version catalog, the enforced dependency platform, the published BOM, Java-version boundaries, shaded client jars and docs generation.

components.title: Test infrastructure, benchmarks and the perf client
components.one_line: Integration tests on Docker, the performance-testing framework, JMH microbenchmarks, pulsar-perf, and the shared test listeners and BookKeeper mocks.
evidence: tests/integration, tests/performance (each with its own AGENTS.md)
microbench/build.gradle.kts depends on managed-ledger, pulsar-broker, pulsar-client-v5, pulsar-testclient

components.title: Distribution, Docker images and deployment
components.one_line: Server, shell and offloader tarballs, the Docker images, the default configuration and launch scripts, and the deployment examples.
evidence: distribution/server/build.gradle.kts (broker, proxy, functions worker, metadata, package storage, auth plugins, tools)

components.title: The PIP process
components.one_line: How Pulsar Improvement Proposals are numbered, written, reviewed as pull requests and voted on.
evidence: ARCHITECTURE.md: 'A PIP number is reserved by the first dev@ thread that uses it'
